description: Guardian plugin default configuration. Override with ~/.config/claude-code/guardian.json (global) or .claude/guardian.json (project-specific)

preCommitReview.description: Pre-commit workflow: execute git adds, format, lint, and run pre-commit hooks
preCommitReview.comment_description: No LLM code review runs here. review-changes.py is a manual tool - see scripts/review-changes.py in the marketplace repo.
preCommitReview.comment_triggers: Which commands trigger the pre-commit review workflow

workflow.comment_executeGitAdds: Execute any 'git add' commands found in the commit command
workflow.comment_stashUnstaged: Stash unstaged changes to isolate what's being committed

runFormatLint.comment_enabled: Disabled by default. Enable in project config and configure tools.
runFormatLint.comment_usePlugin: If true, use format-and-lint plugin if available, otherwise fall back to repo script
runFormatLint.comment_repoScriptPath: Path to repo-specific format script (relative to repo root)

runPreCommitHooks.description: Run pre-commit framework hooks if .pre-commit-config.yaml exists
runPreCommitHooks.comment_maxIterations: Max iterations when hooks modify files (prevents infinite loops)

stopValidation.description: Validation checks when Claude Code session stops
stopValidation.comment_enabled: Disabled by default - very strict. Enable per-project if desired.
stopValidation.comment_returnCode: Exit code used when an 'error' level check fails (2 = block the stop)
stopValidation.comment_skipInRemote: Skip all stop validation in remote Claude Code sessions
stopValidation.comment_levels: Level semantics: 'ignore' skips the check; 'warn' reports the issue to the user without blocking the stop; 'error' blocks the stop and sends the issue back to Claude. Only 'error' blocks.

formatAndLint.description: Run format/lint commands before session end
formatAndLint.comment_commands: Project-specific format/lint commands, e.g. ['npm run format', 'npm run lint']

validation.comment_uncommittedChanges: How to handle uncommitted changes: 'ignore', 'warn', or 'error'
validation.comment_unpushedCommits: How to handle unpushed commits: 'ignore', 'warn', or 'error'. Only reports when the branch actually carries commits that aren't on its upstream, or has commits ahead of the base branch with no upstream at all.
validation.comment_noPr: How to handle no PR created for current branch: 'ignore', 'warn', or 'error'. Only runs when a PR is genuinely the missing next step: on a real branch (not detached HEAD), not the trunk, with commits ahead of the base branch, already pushed to an upstream, and where the PR lookup itself succeeded. A merged or closed PR only counts while its head commit is still the branch head, so a reused branch isn't covered by its previous PR.

oneshotMode.comment_strictRequirements: Each requirement may be set to false to drop it. A missing key uses the default of true.
oneshotMode.comment_allowFailureFile: If this file exists, allow failure with reason from file
